The test image shows soybean leaves with a striking orange-bronze to reddish discoloration across the upper leaf surfaces, giving a leathery, sunburned appearance. The lower leaves appear more severely affected while upper ones retain more green. This pattern is consistent with Cercospora leaf blight.

Let me check one reference image to confirm.

The reference shows early Cercospora with discrete reddish-purple spots. The test image shows a more advanced stage where those spots have coalesced into the characteristic orange-bronze, leathery "sunburned" appearance described for Cercospora leaf blight. This progression matches perfectly — individual spots merging into large reddish-bronze necrotic areas across the upper leaf surface.
